# rwx Provider

The RWX provider enables Terraform to manage RWX vaults, access grants, secrets, variables, OIDC tokens, groups, service accounts, direct permissions, group relationships, and directory-group mappings.

Use [groups](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/rwx-cloud/rwx/latest/docs/resources/group) and [service accounts](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/rwx-cloud/rwx/latest/docs/resources/service_account) to manage identities and their access. For directory sync, connect a directory in the RWX UI, then use the [directory data source](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/rwx-cloud/rwx/latest/docs/data-sources/directory) and [directory-group mappings](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/rwx-cloud/rwx/latest/docs/resources/directory_group_mapping).

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "rwx" {
  access_token = "<rwx-token>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) The access token for RWX's API. This may also be provided via the `RWX_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `host` (String) The URI for RWX's API. Default: `cloud.rwx.com`. This attribute may also be provided via the `RWX_HOST` environment variable. It is usually only needed for testing or development of the Terraform provider itself.
